hints.title: Door Priority State
hints.text: Track the second the door was last used and whether it was used for entering or exiting.

hints.title: Two Waiting Lines
hints.text: Maintain separate first-in-first-out queues for people waiting to enter and people waiting to exit.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Policy
hints.text: If both enter and exit candidates wait: if unused in previous second or previously used for exit, exit goes first; otherwise enter goes first.

hints.title: Door Priority Simulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Each person enters and leaves queues once in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Second-by-second increment without jumping idle periods wastes time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for enter and exit queues.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models door tie-breaking logic cleanly with two queues.
